work_completed: Added sandbox-backed ls and find operations to mvp/src/sandbox/operations.ts: listing through the sandbox shell (bash ls -1), directory checks through the sandbox shell (test -d), and a bounded glob walk for find, all behind the harness policy and confined to the workspace root.

Extended SandboxToolOperations with ls and find; the runner now registers Pi's createLsToolDefinition and createFindToolDefinition with those operations, so the governed turn offers bash/read/write/edit/ls/find.

Tests: mvp/test/sandbox-operations.test.ts (listing, directory checks, glob with ignore and limit, confinement refusals, policy review) and mvp/test/agent-runner.test.ts (ls and find tool calls run through the sandbox; an ls pointing outside the workspace is refused without running).
blockers: Typecheck (tsc) and biome could not run in this container: the TypeScript 7 native binary and Biome CLI have no prebuilt binaries for the platform. Must be run by the owner or in CI before merge.
No Kilo client, no live gateway/sandbox/OIDC run, and no real sandbox workspace root were verified in this session (unchanged from NLTPI-MVP-005).
decisions_made: Incorporate more of the Pi coding-agent capability set into the MVP agent turn: the read-only discovery tools (ls, find) via Pi's own tool factories over the sandbox operations.
Keep grep as a bash-only capability: Pi's grep factory cannot execute sandboxed through its operations interface.
Keep the new tools on the existing policy + confinement seam; no new authority boundary, credential, dependency, egress or persistence decision.
decisions_pending: Owner direction on what else to incorporate next: a separate grep tool (would need an upstream change), MCP servers, extensions, skills, prompt templates, context files, subagents, compaction.
Owner answers still open from NLTPI-MVP-005: route access control, approval defaults, cost, model provider retention.
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: The governed MVP agent turn now composes: crisis gate, free model, sandbox lock, bash/read/write/edit/ls/find tools bound to policy-reviewed sandbox operations, built-in host tools disabled, no host resources loaded. The route stays off unless the owner sets NLT_AGENT_ENABLED=1 per environment; the credential is read inside the turn and kept in memory; egress is the owner-set allowlist with an explicit allow-all option; approvals run without extra prompts inside the sandbox. Next increments on the same thread: a first real sandbox/gateway run by the owner, then more Pi capability surface (for example MCP or subagents) only with the owner's direction and an updated risk decision.
handoff_record.tests_run: mvp vitest --run for mvp/test/sandbox-operations.test.ts (38 passed) and mvp/test/agent-runner.test.ts (21 passed) in the cloud container after hydrating model data; full mvp vitest suite has pre-existing environment-only failures (missing @neurolift-technologies/asfdk package resolution, root-user EACCES assumptions, real-shell lock timeouts), unrelated to this change.
